race.comment: SICILIAN PRINCESS (8) made progress last season, if finding that post-maiden win hard to come by, and that should not be far away this prep after finishing runner-up on the main course here 2 weeks ago. She drops 3kg, and can go one better. SHYSTAR (5) has started this season with a couple of fair efforts in Victoria, and she will have the blinkers back on for her peak run here. Stick with her on an each-way basis. STAR OF OMAHA (9) was only a length from the winner when sixth fresh up at Bendigo, and the powerful Ciaron Maher stable seldom trek to this course unless they are very confident. She slides down slightly in class, and can figure in the top 3 here. TRIPOD TERROR (7) may not win often, but he is still very consistent at this level. The winkers replace the blinkers, and another honest effort is on the cards. STARTIDE (10) dropped down in class and unleashed a big finish to score easily at Murray Bridge. If the tempo is genuine in this, then she is a top 4 hope again.
